behavior_summary: The controller remains in LIGHTS_OFF unless a welcome request with a healthy battery or an applicable ignition condition is present. A welcome request takes priority and enters COURTESY. Manual mode with ignition on selects POSITION; automatic mode selects LOW_BEAM at or below 40 lux. POSITION changes to LOW_BEAM when the automatic dark-light condition becomes true. LOW_BEAM returns to POSITION in manual mode, or to LIGHTS_OFF when ignition is off or automatic mode detects more than 40 lux. COURTESY keeps the low beam on until the battery is not OK or 30,000 ms have elapsed.

transitions.condition: welcome_request is true and battery_ok is true; this branch has priority over the ignition branches.
ignition_on is true and auto_mode is false, provided the welcome-request branch did not match.
ignition_on is true, auto_mode is true, and ambient_lux is at most 40, provided earlier branches did not match.
ignition_on is true, auto_mode is true, and ambient_lux is at most 40.
ignition_on is false, or ignition_on is true and auto_mode is true with ambient_lux greater than 40; ignition-off is checked first.
ignition_on is true and auto_mode is false, provided the ignition-off branch did not match.

transitions.trigger_event: battery status change or courtesy timer expiration
transitions.condition: battery_ok is false or courtesy_elapsed_ms is at least 30000.
